title: Copy a nested object
summary: A nested object needs its own copy when you change one of its fields.
introduction: A nested object needs its own copy when you change one of its fields. Your task: Change the colour while preserving the name.

blocks.text: A nested object needs its own copy when you change one of its fields. This keeps old state values unchanged.
Use a React project with Zustand 5 installed. Hook examples belong in React components; vanilla examples use zustand/vanilla. These package imports require your own build tool.
